title: Type confusion in PostgreSQL extended statistics allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating…
description: A type confusion vulnerability in PostgreSQL extended statistics allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the operating system user running the database. This occurs via a statistics expression of an anonymous RECORD type whose backend-local type identifier denotes a different row type in another session. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
